context: Aoi and Riku talk about a jazz concert.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ジャズ/サイン/原作/シート/見かけ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、ジャズのライブに行ったよ!
lines.en: Yesterday I went to a jazz live show!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、いいシートで聴けた?
lines.en: Nice, did you get a good seat?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 前のシートで、迫力満点だったよ。
lines.en: From a front seat, it was powerful.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、CDにサインをもらったんだ!
lines.en: Yeah, I got an autograph on a CD!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そのジャズ、映画の原作にもなったよね。
lines.en: That jazz became a film's original work too, right?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 原作の本も、読んでみたいな。
lines.en: I want to read the original book too.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅で、その演奏家を見かけたよ!
lines.en: I spotted that musician at the station!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
